arguments.code:
# Check slugify behavior
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-c', '''
from markdown.extensions.toc import slugify

# Test various inputs
tests = [
    "`<test>`",
    "<test>",
    "escaped\\x0295\\x03character",
]
for t in tests:
    print(f"Input: {repr(t)}")
    print(f"Slugify: {repr(slugify(t, '-'))}")
    print()
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)
print("STDOUT:", result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-200:])
